description: One of two MiG-21 airframes in the open-air collection at Turanj; mapped as OpenStreetMap node/10067305478; no serial recorded; the Karlovac collection presents Yugoslav People's Army equipment captured or abandoned in the Homeland War so a Yugoslav rather than Croatian operator is the more likely reading; that is not established and the operator field records Yugoslav service

Second MiG-21 airframe at Turanj; mapped as OpenStreetMap node/10295018395 and explicitly noted by the surveyor as a demolished MiG-21 — that is; a stripped or wrecked hull rather than a complete aircraft; recorded because it is deliberately retained and publicly presented inside a ticketed museum; no serial
